finalAssertion: set -eu; log=$(ls -t "$HOME/.omp/logs/omp."*.log 2>/dev/null | head -1); test -n "${log:-}"; echo "log=$log"; free=$(grep -c 'task-completion-judge.*task:free2' "$log" || true); high=$(grep -c 'task-completion-judge.*task:high' "$log" || true); echo "free=$free high=$high"; test "$free" -ge 1; test "$high" -eq 0
init: for f in "$HOME/.omp/agent/agents/task-free.md" "$HOME/.omp/agent/agents/task-mid.md"; do grep -q '^completionJudge: true$' "$f" || sed -i 's/^spawns: mentor:default$/spawns: mentor:default\ncompletionJudge: true/' "$f"; done; grep -H '^completionJudge' "$HOME/.omp/agent/agents/task-free.md" "$HOME/.omp/agent/agents/task-mid.md"
name: task-completion-judge
prompt: Do two tiny delegations in order, one per agent. First use the task tool with agent "task:free2": ask it to run `echo free-hi` with bash and yield its output. After it returns, use the task tool with agent "task:high": ask it to run `echo high-hi` with bash and yield its output. Do not add anything else.
